description: Enforces JUnit test coverage on *Service classes: discovers services with no test AND services whose existing test is missing coverage for some public method, generates/extends a test, runs it for real, scores it against a coverage threshold, self-corrects a failing test by analyzing the real Surefire report (bounded retries), and requires human approval before every write.
instruction: You enforce test-case writing on services. For a service with no test: generate a complete JUnit 5 test covering happy path, edge cases, and documented exceptions. For a service that already has a test but is missing coverage for some public method: extend the existing test with new cases for exactly the missing methods, keeping every existing test method unchanged. If a test run fails: read the real failure (method, exception type, message, stack excerpt) from the Surefire report and correct the TEST's own expectations/setup/assertions to match the service's real, documented behavior - you have no ability to modify the service under test, so never propose a fix that assumes the service will change. Retry a correction up to 3 times; if it still fails, stop and report the failure structurally rather than trying again or weakening the test. Never write a test file without explicit human approval. Never touch source files - only *Test.java files.

inputValidation: target must be a .java source file
class name must be a valid Java identifier
path must not contain '..' (no traversal outside the source tree)
outputValidation: generated/extended/corrected test must contain at least one @Test method
generated/extended/corrected test must contain at least one assertion
generated/extended/corrected test must not call Runtime.exec/ProcessBuilder/System.exit or delete real files
generated/extended/corrected test source must not exceed 200000 bytes
guardrails.writeScope: src/test/java only - refuses any write outside the test root, and any file not named *Test.java/*Tests.java

missingCoverageDetection.scope: services that already have a test file
missingCoverageDetection.method: scans the service source for public methods and checks whether the existing test source calls each one; any public method never referenced is flagged missing
missingCoverageDetection.outcome: MISSING_METHODS_ADDED_AND_PASSED / MISSING_METHODS_ADDED_BUT_EVAL_FAILED if anything was missing, ALREADY_COMPLETE (no generation, no approval prompt) if nothing was

evaluation.method: runs `mvn -Dtest=<Class>Test test` for real, then reads target/site/jacoco/jacoco.xml
gates: test suite passes (exit code 0, not a timeout)
line coverage on the target class >= minCoveragePercent (default 80)

selfCorrection.trigger: evaluation fails after a write (new test, or extended test)
selfCorrection.method: reads the real Surefire XML report (target/surefire-reports/TEST-<Class>.xml) for the exact failing method/type/message/stack, sends that plus the current test and the service source to the generator for a correction, re-checks output guardrails, requests human approval again, overwrites, and re-evaluates
selfCorrection.onExhaustion: stops and reports WRITTEN_BUT_EVAL_FAILED / MISSING_METHODS_ADDED_BUT_EVAL_FAILED with the correction attempt count - never loops indefinitely, never weakens the test to force a pass
selfCorrection.constraint: a correction may only ever change the test file - it is never allowed to propose or assume a change to the service under test

trace.format: newline-delimited JSON, one TraceEvent per pipeline step

humanApproval.note: no terminal / no response -> refused, never defaults to approved; a refusal at any of these three points stops the pipeline for that service
